## DPStyleARWebLive.grab() method

Capture the latest frame from the active camera module. This method performs one frame-grab operation when the camera module has already been started.

**Signature:**

```typescript
grab(): Promise<boolean>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;boolean&gt;

A promise resolving to true when a frame is successfully captured, otherwise false.
